newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia late taxpayers in last chance to pay.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia late taxpayers in last chance to pay.

text.p: Philadelphia is giving taxpayers one last chance to pay up before some accounts are given to a collection agency next week.
That chance will come Saturday, when payment windows will be open at the Municipal Services Building from 0800 EDT until 1300.
If taxes are not current by Monday or a payment agreement is in place, the collection agency could add up to 18 percent for a collection fee in addition to what the taxpayers already owe.
Philadelphia is planning a $180 million tax lien securitization, and the stepped up enforcement is part of the process leading up to the sale.
